artifact_reasoning: The image suffers from moderate artifacts typical of AI-generated underwater scenes. The primary issue is 'texture_anomaly' (over-smoothed skin lacking dermal denticles) and 'edge_bleeding' (soft, melting boundaries between the shark and the water, particularly at the tail tip). While the Perceptual Auditor attributed low severity to noise/blur, the Reflector identifies the uniform smoothness and slight haloing as generative artifacts rather than just optical blur. The severity is moderate (3.85) because these defects degrade realism but do not destroy the structural integrity of the subject.
